iphone.title: Apple announces iPhone 17 lineup with A19 chip
iphone.snippet: Apple unveiled the iPhone 17 series powered by the new A19 chip. The base model starts at $799 and ships September 19. Apple says the A19 delivers 30 percent better GPU performance than the A18.

iphone.title: iPhone 17 Pro camera upgrades detailed
iphone.snippet: The iPhone 17 Pro adds a 48MP telephoto lens with 5x optical zoom. ProRes RAW video recording is now supported at 4K 60fps.

iphone.title: iPhone 17 battery life test results
iphone.snippet: Lab tests show the iPhone 17 lasts 22 hours in mixed usage, up from 19 hours for the iPhone 16. Charging reaches 50 percent in 30 minutes.

iphone.title: iPhone 17 display: 120Hz across all models
iphone.snippet: For the first time, every iPhone 17 model including the base version gets a 120Hz ProMotion display. Peak outdoor brightness reaches 3000 nits.

iphone.title: iPhone 17 India pricing announced
iphone.snippet: In India the iPhone 17 starts at Rs 79,900 and the Pro at Rs 1,19,900. Pre-orders open September 13 with availability from September 19.

iphone.title: Analysts: iPhone 17 upgrade cycle strongest since 2021
iphone.snippet: Supply chain estimates suggest Apple ordered 92 million iPhone 17 units for the launch quarter. Analysts attribute demand to the 120Hz base display and camera upgrades.

iphone.title: iPhone 17 eSIM-only in more countries
iphone.snippet: Apple expanded eSIM-only iPhone 17 availability to 20 additional countries. India continues to get SIM tray models, according to carrier documentation.

gate.title: IIT announces GATE 2026 syllabus revision
gate.snippet: The organizing IIT revised the GATE 2026 syllabus for computer science, adding topics in linear algebra and machine learning fundamentals. The exam will be held on February 7, 8, 14 and 15.

gate.title: GATE 2026 registration dates and fees
gate.snippet: GATE 2026 registration opens August 25 and closes October 3 without late fee. The regular fee is Rs 900 for female, SC, ST and PwD candidates and Rs 1,800 for others.

gate.title: Two new papers added to GATE 2026
gate.snippet: GATE 2026 introduces a Data Science and Artificial Intelligence paper with code DA. Candidates can now choose up to two papers from a combined list.

gate.title: GATE 2026 exam pattern changes
gate.snippet: The GATE 2026 paper retains 65 questions worth 100 marks over 3 hours. Multiple select questions carry negative marking, while numerical answer type questions do not.

gate.title: GATE score validity extended
gate.snippet: GATE 2026 scores remain valid for three years from the date of result announcement. Results are expected on March 19.

gate.title: PSU recruitment through GATE 2026
gate.snippet: Over 40 public sector undertakings including IOCL and BHEL use GATE 2026 scores for recruitment. Most PSUs shortlist candidates above the 85 percentile.

masters.title: Step-by-step guide to applying for a masters abroad
masters.snippet: A foreign masters application has six steps: shortlist programs, take required tests, prepare documents, submit applications, arrange funding, and apply for the visa. Most students complete the cycle in 8 to 12 months.

masters.title: GRE and language test requirements 2026
masters.snippet: Many universities in the US and Germany now waive the GRE for masters applicants with strong academics. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 remains the common English requirement.

masters.title: How much does a foreign masters actually cost
masters.snippet: Tuition for a two-year masters ranges from 20,000 dollars in Germany public universities to 60,000 dollars in the US. Living costs add 800 to 1,500 dollars per month depending on the city.

masters.title: Statement of purpose mistakes to avoid
masters.snippet: Admissions officers report that generic statements of purpose are the most common rejection reason. Strong SOPs connect specific research interests to named faculty and labs.

masters.title: Student visa interview success rate data
masters.snippet: The US F-1 visa approval rate for Indian students was 72 percent last year. Genuine intent, clear funding proof and program knowledge are the top deciding factors.

masters.title: Scholarships for Indian masters students
masters.snippet: Popular funding options include DAAD for Germany, Chevening for the UK and university-specific graduate assistantships in the US. Assistantships often cover full tuition plus a stipend.
